children: Glencore plc (LSE:GLEN) faces a $2B Singapore lawsuit and internal probes—suspending iron‑ore head Peter Hill over ties to trader Radiant World and booking a sub-$500M provision—while selling assets and crude, extending vendor loans and facing worker protests over local jobs and wages.

: Glencore plc (GLEN) sued in Singapore by Radiant World and Sapphire Minmetals for ~$2B over a decade-long deal; Glencore says it found falsified documents, booked provision under $500M, will contest.
: Glencore plc (GLEN) suspended Peter Hill, head of Iron Ore, amid a review of ties with trader Radiant World; emails show Hill urged Radiant World not to disclose information.
: Glencore plc (GLEN) is among traders using offtake deals to market Congo’s copper under a 2025 US-backed minerals pact, aiming to shift sales from traditional channels.
: Glencore plc (GLEN) sold Access World in 2022 for $176.7M and extended a vendor loan later raised to $140M. By Mar 31 current year the buyer owed ~ $108.9M, incl. ~$20.3M interest.
: Glencore plc (GLEN) sold 1 million barrels of Angolan Cabinda crude to Indian Oil Corp for November delivery, with the cargo priced at a premium of about $17 per barrel to October dated Brent.
: Ulan Underground workers, backed by Australia's Mining & Energy Union, will rally in Mudgee Thu–Fri to protest Glencore plc (GLEN) over alleged lack of local jobs and fair local wages.
